pattern_explanation: Turkish speakers may see the Turkish word transliterated as fabrika and assume it matches the English word fabric, because the spellings are close. The two words come from different sources and have different meanings.
false_friend_warning: The Turkish word transliterated as fabrika means factory, not fabric. English fabric means cloth or material, so the correct English match is factory, and the Turkish word transliterated as kumas is the one that means fabric.
